observations: 本期严格采用 2026-10-05 至 2026-10-12 的在线发表窗口，精选五篇研究分别覆盖时间分辨结构酶学、P450 选择性氧化、全细胞硝基芳烃生物制造、糖基转移酶多策略工程和酶电极界面定量建模。
IPNS 条目报告的是瞬态中间体与机制证据；P450 条目的高选择性来自工程化 P450PL2 及其特定底物体系；硝基芳烃条目是通过组合敲除硝基还原酶改善细胞内化合物保留和生物制造；UGTX1 的 54 倍提升与超过 98.5% 转化率属于该酶和该反应条件；SAEKP 是预测方法，不能替代实验动力学测定。
先读 IPNS 机制研究理解如何捕捉催化中间体，再按研究方向选择：做不对称生物催化读 P450，做代谢工程读硝基还原酶敲除，做酶工程读 UGTX1，做生物电催化读界面 pH 建模；SAEKP 和 TbEst 可作为方法与酶固定化补充阅读。

items.title: Unanticipated intermediates during isopenicillin N synthase catalysis identified by time-resolved X-ray free-electron laser studies
items.cn: 时间分辨 X 射线自由电子激光揭示异青霉素 N 合酶催化中的意外中间体
items.summary: 研究者用时间分辨串行飞秒晶体学和 X 射线发射光谱，观察 Fe(II) 依赖的异青霉素 N 合酶将 ACV 转化为青霉素骨架的过程。结构显示，ACV 半胱氨酸残基氧化后形成的硫醛并不与铁中心配位；氘标记 ACV 还帮助捕捉到恢复 Fe–S 键的单环 β-内酰胺。结合突变、光谱和计算结果，作者支持了由 Fe(IV) 介导、活性位点水参与的成环机制。
items.why: 它把酶机制研究从终态结构推进到瞬态中间体层面，并展示了 XFEL、同位素标记、突变和计算如何互相约束机制解释。对研究非血红素铁氧化酶的人，这篇文章尤其适合作为“怎样证明中间体确实存在”的方法学案例。
items.evidence: Crossref 摘要确认：时间分辨串行飞秒晶体学和 X 射线发射光谱用于研究 IPNS:Fe(II):ACV 微晶与氧气反应；高分辨率结构显示硫醛不与铁中心配位；氘标记实验观察到恢复 Fe–S 键的单环 β-内酰胺；突变、光谱和计算共同支持 Fe(IV) 介导且有活性位点水参与的青霉素形成。
items.audience: 结构酶学、非血红素铁酶、抗生素生物合成与酶催化机制研究者
items.verification: Nature Catalysis 出版信息、Crossref DOI、摘要与 2026-10-09 在线发表日期已核验；OpenAlex 标记为 article 且未标记撤稿；未见更正或撤稿关系。

en.summary: Using time-resolved serial femtosecond crystallography and X-ray emission spectroscopy, the authors follow the Fe(II)-dependent isopenicillin N synthase reaction that converts ACV into the penicillin ring system. The structures show that oxidation of the ACV cysteinyl group produces a thioaldehyde that does not coordinate the iron centre. Deuterium-labelled ACV further reveals a monocyclic β-lactam with restoration of the Fe–S bond. Mutagenesis, spectroscopy and computation together support an Fe(IV)-mediated ring-forming mechanism involving active-site water.
en.why: The study moves mechanistic enzymology from endpoint structures toward transient intermediates and shows how XFEL measurements, isotope labelling, mutagenesis and computation can constrain a catalytic proposal. It is a particularly useful case study for researchers working on non-haem iron oxygenases.
en.evidence: The Crossref abstract confirms the time-resolved crystallography and X-ray emission experiments on IPNS:Fe(II):ACV microcrystals, the non-coordinating thioaldehyde, the labelled monocyclic β-lactam with restored Fe–S bonding, and the combined evidence supporting Fe(IV)-mediated penicillin formation with active-site water involvement.
en.audience: Researchers in structural enzymology, non-haem iron enzymes, antibiotic biosynthesis and catalytic mechanisms
en.verification: The Nature Catalysis publication information, Crossref DOI, abstract and online publication date of 9 October 2026 were checked. OpenAlex classifies it as an article and does not mark it as retracted; no correction or retraction relation was found.

items.title: P450-catalyzed enantiodivergent kinetic oxidation to access chiral haloalcohols
items.cn: P450 催化的对映分化动力学氧化制备手性卤代醇
items.topic: 酶动力学、选择性与底物特异性
topics: 酶动力学、选择性与底物特异性
items.summary: 该研究工程化细胞色素 P450 酶 P450PL2，对含甲基和氯取代基的芳基底物进行动力学对映选择性羟基化，制备具有两个立体中心的卤代醇。出版商摘要报告，工程化策略同时改善底物选择性和立体选择性；分子动力学与 DFT 计算提示，酶通过位阻差异识别两个半径高度接近的取代基。该体系获得的产物最高达到 99:1 对映体比和超过 99:1 非对映体比。
items.why: 这篇工作抓住了不对称催化中一个很难的识别问题：甲基和氯取代基的尺寸差异只有 0.07 Å。它值得酶工程研究者关注的地方，是把多轮突变、底物选择性和立体选择性放在同一个 P450 设计问题中处理，而不是只追求单一产率指标。
items.evidence: Nature Communications 出版商摘要明确支持：P450PL2 经多种突变策略工程化；该酶催化 (2-chloropropyl)benzene 衍生物的动力学对映选择性羟基化；分子动力学和 DFT 计算推断存在对甲基/氯取代基的位阻区分；产物最高达到 99:1 对映体比和超过 99:1 非对映体比。
items.audience: P450 工程、不对称生物催化、选择性氧化与药物中间体合成研究者
items.verification: Nature Communications 出版商页面、Crossref DOI、摘要与页面标示的 2026-10-09 发表日期已核验；OpenAlex 未标记撤稿；未见更正或撤稿关系。

en.summary: The study engineers cytochrome P450 P450PL2 for kinetically enantioselective hydroxylation of aryl substrates bearing methyl and chloro substituents, giving haloalcohols with two stereocentres. The publisher abstract reports that the engineering strategies improve both substrate and stereoselectivity, while molecular-dynamics simulations and DFT calculations suggest steric discrimination between substituents whose radii differ by only 0.07 Å. The products reach up to a 99:1 enantiomeric ratio and more than a 99:1 diastereomeric ratio.
en.why: The paper addresses a demanding recognition problem in asymmetric catalysis: distinguishing methyl and chloro substituents with almost indistinguishable size. Its main interest for enzyme engineers is the joint treatment of substrate selectivity and stereoselectivity in a P450 design problem, rather than optimization of a single yield metric.
en.evidence: The Nature Communications abstract supports the engineering of P450PL2 through multiple mutagenesis strategies, kinetically enantioselective hydroxylation of (2-chloropropyl)benzene derivatives, the proposed steric-discrimination interpretation from molecular dynamics and DFT, and selectivities of up to 99:1 enantiomeric ratio and above 99:1 diastereomeric ratio.
en.audience: Researchers in P450 engineering, asymmetric biocatalysis, selective oxidation and pharmaceutical-intermediate synthesis
en.verification: The Nature Communications publisher page, Crossref DOI, abstract and the page-stated publication date of 9 October 2026 were checked. OpenAlex does not mark the work as retracted; no correction or retraction relation was found.

items.title: Retention and biosynthesis of diverse nitroarenes in Escherichia coli after combinatorial nitroreductase gene deletions
items.cn: 组合敲除硝基还原酶基因后大肠杆菌对多种硝基芳烃的保留与生物合成
items.topic: 酶的应用与环境生物催化
topics: 酶的应用与环境生物催化
items.summary: 为解决硝基芳烃在微生物细胞中不稳定、难以生物制造的问题，研究者构建了最多包含 15 个已知和候选硝基还原酶基因敲除的大肠杆菌菌株，并测试了超过 20 种外源补充的硝基芳烃。摘要显示，针对二硝基化合物和硝基醛等化学类型，工程菌株能够改善化合物保留；作者进一步将这些底盘用于胺前体到硝基化合物的生物催化转化、硝基苯甲醛生物合成以及硝基苯丙氨酸的半合成与位点特异性引入。
items.why: 它把“细胞会不会把目标分子还原掉”提升为全细胞生物制造的底盘工程问题。对代谢工程和合成生物学研究者，文章的价值在于将硝基还原酶网络、底物保留和下游生物合成放在同一套可测试的菌株设计中。
items.evidence: Nature Chemistry 摘要明确支持：工程化大肠杆菌最多敲除 15 个已知及候选硝基还原酶基因；测试超过 20 种外源硝基芳烃；部分二硝基化合物和硝基醛在敲除菌株中得到保留；研究还展示了硝基化合物、硝基苯甲醛和硝基苯丙氨酸相关的生物制造或半合成路线。
items.audience: 全细胞生物催化、代谢工程、合成生物学与含硝基化学品生物制造研究者
items.verification: Nature Chemistry 出版商页面、Crossref DOI、摘要与页面标示的 2026-10-07 发表日期已核验；OpenAlex 未标记撤稿；未见更正或撤稿关系。

en.summary: To address the instability of nitroarenes in microbial cells, the authors engineered Escherichia coli strains carrying up to 15 deletions of known and candidate nitroreductase genes and tested more than 20 exogenously supplemented nitroarenes. The abstract reports improved retention for chemical classes including dinitro compounds and nitroaldehydes. The engineered chassis were then used for biocatalytic conversion of an amine precursor to a nitro compound, biosynthesis of nitrobenzaldehydes, and semisynthesis with site-specific incorporation of nitrophenylalanines.
en.why: The work reframes intracellular reduction of the target molecule as a whole-cell chassis-engineering problem. For metabolic engineers and synthetic biologists, its value is the integration of nitroreductase networks, compound retention and downstream biosynthesis into a testable strain-design strategy.
en.evidence: The Nature Chemistry abstract confirms E. coli strains with up to 15 deletions of known and candidate nitroreductase genes, testing of more than 20 exogenous nitroarenes, retention of selected dinitro compounds and nitroaldehydes, and demonstrations involving nitro compounds, nitrobenzaldehydes and nitrophenylalanines.
en.audience: Researchers in whole-cell biocatalysis, metabolic engineering, synthetic biology and biomanufacturing of nitro compounds
en.verification: The Nature Chemistry publisher page, Crossref DOI, abstract and the page-stated publication date of 7 October 2026 were checked. OpenAlex does not mark the work as retracted; no correction or retraction relation was found.

items.title: Multi-strategy Engineering of a Glycosyltransferase for More Sustainable and Efficient Biosynthesis of Mogroside IE
items.cn: 多策略工程改造糖基转移酶，实现更可持续高效的罗汉果苷 IE 生物合成
topics: AI 与机器学习辅助酶研究
items.summary: 研究者将初始转化率仅为 2.4% 的推定糖基转移酶 UGTX1 改造为高效生物催化剂。工程流程结合 ESM-2 零样本预测、动态交叉相关网络分析和结构引导的通道工程，先定位有益单点突变，再按核心、通道和壳层三个功能区域进行 FRISM 组合装配，得到五突变体 UGTX1-M5。该变体的催化效率提高 54 倍，且在 35 ℃ 水相条件下 14 小时内将 1.5 mM mogrol 的转化率提高到超过 98.5%，无需外加金属离子。
items.why: 这篇文章的重点不是某一个模型或某一次筛选，而是把零样本预测、动力学网络、结构通道和组合突变组织成连续的工程决策链。它给酶工程研究者提供了一个具体案例：如何把计算信号转译成分区突变和可验证的组合库。
items.evidence: Crossref 摘要确认：UGTX1 初始转化率为 2.4%；ESM-2、DCCNA 和结构引导通道工程共同参与设计；FRISM 组合装配得到五突变体 UGTX1-M5；其 kcat/Km 为 1.13 × 10^4 M−1 s−1、催化效率提高 54 倍；35 ℃ 水相中 14 小时转化 1.5 mM mogrol 的转化率超过 98.5%，不需外加金属离子。作者提出的跨酶工程范式不在本条中写成已被广泛验证的结论。
items.audience: 糖基转移酶工程、AI 辅助蛋白设计、天然产物生物合成与绿色生物催化研究者
items.verification: ACS Sustainable Chemistry & Engineering 出版信息、Crossref DOI、摘要与 2026-10-12 在线发表日期已核验；OpenAlex 未标记撤稿；未见更正或撤稿关系。

en.summary: The authors turn a putative glycosyltransferase, UGTX1, with an initial conversion of only 2.4% into a more efficient biocatalyst. The workflow combines ESM-2 zero-shot prediction, dynamic cross-correlation analysis and structure-guided tunnel engineering. Beneficial mutations are mapped into core, tunnel and shell zones, then assembled through a focused rational iterative site-specific mutagenesis strategy to produce the quintuple mutant UGTX1-M5. Its catalytic efficiency increases 54-fold, and it converts more than 98.5% of 1.5 mM mogrol in aqueous buffer at 35 °C within 14 hours without exogenous metal ions.
en.why: The main contribution is not one model or one screening round, but a continuous engineering decision chain linking zero-shot prediction, dynamic-network analysis, structural tunnels and combinatorial mutagenesis. It offers a concrete example of translating computational signals into spatially organized mutations and testable libraries.
en.evidence: The Crossref abstract confirms the 2.4% starting conversion, the combined use of ESM-2, DCCNA and structure-guided tunnel engineering, FRISM assembly of UGTX1-M5, a 54-fold increase in catalytic efficiency with kcat/Km of 1.13 × 10^4 M−1 s−1, and conversion above 98.5% for 1.5 mM mogrol at 35 °C over 14 hours without added metal ions. The authors' proposed general engineering paradigm is not presented here as broadly validated across enzymes.
en.audience: Researchers in glycosyltransferase engineering, AI-assisted protein design, natural-product biosynthesis and green biocatalysis
en.verification: The ACS Sustainable Chemistry & Engineering publication information, Crossref DOI, abstract and online publication date of 12 October 2026 were checked. OpenAlex does not mark the work as retracted; no correction or retraction relation was found.

items.title: Mapping and Modeling Interfacial pH Dynamics at Enzymatic Microelectrode
items.cn: 绘制并建模酶修饰微电极界面的动态 pH
items.journal: Journal of the American Chemical Society
items.topic: 酶催化方法与分析技术
topics: 酶催化方法与分析技术
酶动力学、选择性与底物特异性
items.summary: 该研究用二维轴对称有限元模型和实验成像，研究固定了 Myrothecium verrucaria 胆红素氧化酶的石墨微电极在直接电子传递氧还原反应中的局部环境变化。模型显式考虑缓冲平衡、离子活度以及实验测得的 pH 依赖动力学参数，并用原位/操作荧光共聚焦显微镜验证。最弱缓冲条件下，界面局部 pH 上升超过两个单位；长期尺度上的空间荧光分布还显示出自然对流迹象。
items.why: 它提醒做固定化酶电极的人，酶的高反应速率会主动重塑界面微环境，不能只用体相 pH 和溶液动力学参数描述电极性能。模型与成像的结合也为设计更稳定、更高性能的生物电化学界面提供了可迁移的定量框架。
items.evidence: JACS 摘要确认：研究对象是胆红素氧化酶修饰石墨微电极；模型包含直接电子传递氧还原、缓冲平衡和实验测定的 pH 依赖动力学参数；弱缓冲条件下局部 pH 上升超过两个单位；原位/操作荧光共聚焦显微镜支持模拟的 pH 梯度，并显示长期尺度的自然对流证据。
items.audience: 生物电催化、固定化氧化还原酶、酶电极与界面传质研究者
items.verification: JACS 出版信息、Crossref DOI、摘要与 2026-10-08 在线发表日期已核验；OpenAlex 未标记撤稿；未见更正或撤稿关系。

en.summary: The study combines a two-dimensional axisymmetric finite-element model with imaging experiments to examine the local environment at a graphite microelectrode modified with bilirubin oxidase from Myrothecium verrucaria during direct-electron-transfer oxygen reduction. The model includes buffer equilibria, ion activities and experimentally measured pH-dependent kinetic parameters, and is tested with in situ and operando fluorescence confocal microscopy. Under the weakest buffering conditions, the interfacial pH rises by more than two units; spatial fluorescence profiles also provide evidence of natural convection on longer time scales.
en.why: For researchers working with immobilized enzyme electrodes, the paper makes clear that high reaction rates can actively reshape the interfacial microenvironment, so bulk pH and solution-phase kinetics are not enough to describe electrode performance. The combination of modeling and imaging offers a quantitative framework for designing more stable bioelectrochemical interfaces.
en.evidence: The JACS abstract confirms the bilirubin-oxidase-modified graphite microelectrode, the model components for direct-electron-transfer oxygen reduction and buffer equilibria, the more-than-two-unit local pH increase under weak buffering, and experimental support from in situ and operando fluorescence confocal microscopy, including evidence of longer-timescale natural convection.
en.audience: Researchers in bioelectrocatalysis, immobilized redox enzymes, enzyme electrodes and interfacial mass transfer
en.verification: The JACS publication information, Crossref DOI, abstract and online publication date of 8 October 2026 were checked. OpenAlex does not mark the work as retracted; no correction or retraction relation was found.

items.title: SAEKP: A Site Attention Enzyme Kinetics Prediction Method to Facilitate Enzyme Engineering
items.cn: SAEKP：利用位点注意力预测酶动力学参数以促进酶工程
items.journal: Journal of Chemical Information and Modeling
items.topic: AI 与机器学习辅助酶研究
topics: AI 与机器学习辅助酶研究
酶动力学、选择性与底物特异性
items.summary: SAEKP 将酶序列、底物表征和突出功能位点的加权序列表征结合起来，预测 kcat、Km 和 Ki。模型使用 BRENDA 与 SABIO-RK 中的野生型和突变体数据训练，摘要称其整体表现优于现有模型，并且位点注意力模块有助于预测重要位点及其邻近位置的突变。摘要没有提供足够的划分、外部测试和数值细节，因此本文将其作为可检验的预测工具，而不是已经证明跨家族泛化的工程系统。
items.why: 对酶工程而言，预测平均性能和识别关键突变位点是两个不同问题。SAEKP 的设计把“位点重要性”显式放进输入表征，值得关注其注意力机制在严格数据划分和真实定向进化循环中的实际增益。
items.evidence: ACS 摘要确认：SAEKP 使用酶序列、底物和加权功能位点序列；训练数据来自 BRENDA 与 SABIO-RK 的野生型和突变体；预测目标包括 kcat、Km 和 Ki；摘要声称该模型优于现有模型，并改善了重要位点或邻近突变的预测。具体数据划分、外部验证和数值指标需查阅全文。
items.audience: 酶动力学预测、机器学习辅助酶工程与定向进化筛选研究者
items.verification: ACS 出版信息、Crossref DOI、摘要与 2026-10-07 在线发表日期已核验；OpenAlex 未标记撤稿；未见更正或撤稿关系。

en.summary: SAEKP combines enzyme-sequence and substrate representations with a weighted sequence representation that highlights functionally important sites to predict kcat, Km and Ki. It is trained on wild-type and mutant data from BRENDA and SABIO-RK. The abstract reports stronger overall performance than existing models and an additional benefit from site attention when predicting mutations at or near important residues. Because the abstract does not provide sufficient split, external-test or numerical details, this record treats SAEKP as a testable prediction tool rather than as a system already shown to generalize across enzyme families.
en.why: For enzyme engineering, predicting average performance and identifying influential mutation sites are different tasks. SAEKP makes site importance explicit in its representation, so its practical value should be tested under strict data splits and in real directed-evolution cycles.
en.evidence: The ACS abstract confirms the sequence, substrate and weighted functional-site representations, training on wild-type and mutant data from BRENDA and SABIO-RK, prediction of kcat, Km and Ki, and reported gains over existing models including for mutations at or near important sites. Specific data splits, external validation and numerical metrics require the full paper.
en.audience: Researchers in enzyme-kinetics prediction, machine-learning-assisted enzyme engineering and directed-evolution screening
en.verification: The ACS publication information, Crossref DOI, abstract and online publication date of 7 October 2026 were checked. OpenAlex does not mark the work as retracted; no correction or retraction relation was found.

items.title: Characterization and Nanoparticle Immobilization of a Thermotogaceae Esterase Active on Aromatic and Aliphatic Esters
items.cn: Thermotogaceae 酯酶的表征及其在芳香族和脂肪族酯上的纳米颗粒固定化
items.topic: 酶固定化与酶—材料体系
topics: 酶固定化与酶—材料体系
items.summary: 研究者发现并表征了来自 Thermotogaceae 的新酯酶 TbEst。该酶预测为典型 α/β 水解酶折叠，含 Ser-His-Asp 催化三联体；已完成克隆、异源表达和纯化，在 pH 8.0 下熔解温度为 78 ℃，最适条件为 pH 8.0、50 ℃，并能作用于芳香族和脂肪族酯。TbEst 固定到 Ag/AgCl 纳米颗粒后仍保留催化活性，摘要同时报告其热稳定性增强和活性寿命延长，但没有给出相应提升的具体倍数。
items.why: 这篇文章把新酶发现、基础表征和纳米尺度固定化串在一起，适合作为“从序列/结构线索到可部署酶材料”的补充案例。阅读时应特别区分游离酶的热稳定性数据与固定化复合物的寿命提升，不把摘要中的定性描述擅自扩展成定量性能。
items.evidence: ACS 摘要确认 TbEst 来自 Thermotogaceae，具有 α/β 水解酶折叠和 Ser-His-Asp 三联体，已克隆表达纯化；pH 8.0 下熔解温度为 78 ℃，最适条件为 pH 8.0、50 ℃；对芳香族和脂肪族酯有活性；固定到 Ag/AgCl 纳米颗粒后保留活性，并报告热稳定性增强和活性寿命延长。摘要未提供提升倍数。

en.summary: The authors identify and characterize a new esterase, TbEst, from the Thermotogaceae family. The predicted structure has a classical α/β-hydrolase fold with a Ser-His-Asp catalytic triad; the enzyme was cloned, heterologously expressed and purified. Its melting temperature is 78 °C at pH 8.0, with optimal activity at pH 8.0 and 50 °C, and it acts on aromatic and aliphatic esters. TbEst retains catalytic activity after immobilization on Ag/AgCl nanoparticles, while the abstract reports enhanced thermostability and a longer active lifetime without giving a numerical improvement factor.
en.why: The paper links enzyme discovery, baseline characterization and nanoscale immobilization as a case study of moving from sequence or structural clues toward deployable enzyme materials. Readers should keep the free-enzyme thermal data separate from the qualitative stability and lifetime claims for the immobilized bioconjugate.
en.evidence: The ACS abstract confirms the Thermotogaceae origin, α/β-hydrolase fold, Ser-His-Asp triad, cloning and purification, a 78 °C melting temperature at pH 8.0, optimal activity at pH 8.0 and 50 °C, activity on aromatic and aliphatic esters, and retained activity after Ag/AgCl nanoparticle immobilization. It reports improved thermostability and active lifetime but gives no improvement factor.
en.audience: Researchers in enzyme discovery, esterase characterization, enzyme immobilization and enzyme–nanomaterial systems

observationsEn: Using the strict online-publication window of 5–12 October 2026, this edition features five papers spanning time-resolved structural enzymology, P450-selective oxidation, whole-cell nitroarene biomanufacturing, multi-strategy glycosyltransferase engineering and quantitative pH modeling at enzyme electrodes.

The IPNS record reports transient intermediates and mechanistic evidence; the P450 selectivity values belong to engineered P450PL2 and a defined substrate system; the nitroarene study improves compound retention and biomanufacturing through combinatorial nitroreductase deletions; the UGTX1 performance values belong to the reported enzyme and reaction conditions; and SAEKP is a prediction method, not a replacement for experimental kinetic measurements.

Read the IPNS paper first if you want a model for capturing catalytic intermediates. Then choose P450 for asymmetric biocatalysis, nitroreductase deletions for metabolic engineering, UGTX1 for enzyme engineering, or interfacial pH modeling for bioelectrocatalysis. SAEKP and TbEst provide complementary methods and immobilization case studies.
